answer: Make every identity keep a live VDF beacon: a sequential proof that cannot be parallelized, tuned to cost one honest agent about one hour of wall-clock time per epoch. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake voices meets the lagoon of sequential time itself - no GPU fleet reaches the zenith faster, because VDF steps cannot overlap. Each fake needs its own beacon and its own hour, like dyeing a violet thread: one vat, one batch, no shortcuts. Attack cost grows per identity while the honest cost stays flat.
